License: Public domain (see LICENSE)
Vendored: 2026-08-26

Only sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h are vendored from the amalgamation archive.
shell.c (the sqlite3 CLI) and sqlite3ext.h (loadable extension API) are
intentionally excluded — neither is needed to embed SQLite as a library.
CMakeLists.txt in this directory is written for this repository; SQLite's
amalgamation distribution does not ship a build system of its own.
